page.overview:
Who is Adam Rykland?

He was later involved in stealing Vibranium from Wakanda that was currently being sold by N'Kya. When Pepper Potts noticed the Black Panther watching Rykland from above, she decided to follow him upon recognizing him from the field trip. Pepper and the Black Panther located Rykland in an underground facility, though Pepper had accidentally activated the alarm system, thus provoking Rykland to send out the unsuccessful Delta team to deal with the intruders.

Once Rykland met up with N'Kya, he was disappointed upon seeing the Black Knight. Believing the exchange was a scam until he was reassured by N'Kya herself, who decided to raise the price of the Vibranuanim due to recent events. When Iron Man and the Black Panther arrived, Rykland and his men attempted to defeat the Black Panther, though they were subdued by him and were all defeated. Rykland, as well as other individuals involved with the illegal trade, were arrested by S.H.I.E.L.D and sent to The Vault.
